title: JSFL: doc.timelines[] array missing from JsflDocument (multi-scene access)
description: The JsflDocument interface in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts lacks a timelines array property. In Flash 8 JSFL, doc.timelines is an array of all scene timelines (same type as the main timeline). Fix: add readonly timelines: JsflTimeline[] to JsflDocument interface and its proxy. The getter maps over doc.scenes to return one JsflTimeline proxy per scene. Look at how getTimeline() constructs a timeline proxy and replicate for each scene index. The timelines array is read-only (cannot push to it; use scene_add MCP tool instead).
